name: semanticscholar
description: Semantic Scholar, an AI-powered search engine for scientific literature. The CLI searches and looks up papers, authors, citations, references and recommendations through the official Semantic Scholar Academic Graph and Recommendations APIs, and also offers the web app's title autocomplete.

notes: The web app's own data endpoints are protected. POST /api/1/search (E8) always returned 202 with an empty body. Paper and author pages (E9, E11, E12) returned an AWS WAF bot challenge. /search and the api-docs page are disallowed by robots.txt. These were deliberately not turned into commands, and the CLI does not attempt the WAF challenge (E2/E4/E6). Paper, author, citation and recommendation data instead come from Semantic Scholar's official public API at api.semanticscholar.org, which is the sanctioned way to access the data programmatically.

None of the api.semanticscholar.org commands were verified in this recording. The explorer's unauthenticated calls to /graph/v1/paper/search and /graph/v1/paper/<id> returned 429 Too Many Requests, because unauthenticated traffic shares one rate-limited pool. Pass --apiKey (sent as the x-api-key header; free key from https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api) and/or retry with backoff. Keyed access is typically limited to about 1 request per second.
Paper IDs are 40-char hex S2 IDs (the last path segment of /paper/<slug>/<id> URLs). Graph API commands also accept prefixed IDs: DOI:, ARXIV:, CorpusId:, PMID:, PMCID:, ACL:, MAG:, URL:.
Author IDs are the numeric last path segment of /author/<slug>/<id> URLs, e.g. 40348417 for Ashish Vaswani.

search-papers pagination: offset + limit must stay below 1000. If you change --limit, step --offset by the same amount. The response's 'next' field gives the next offset and 'total' gives the match count.
Use --fields to request extra data, e.g. abstract, tldr, externalIds, publicationDate, s2FieldsOfStudy, embedding. Nested author fields use dot syntax, e.g. authors.name.

autocomplete-papers (E3) is the only command that returned 200 in the recording, but its suggestions array was empty for 'transformer attention'. It depends on the internal web API (x-s2-client header) and may start being challenged like /api/1/search.
No logged-in or write capabilities were observed: the explorer was signed out, and the only writes were WAF, consent and analytics calls, which were skipped.
